root_cause: The connector builder UI treated every open CSRD/ESRS impact review as a hard activation denial, while the backend deliberately separates verified technical safety and sovereignty gates from unresolved ESG materiality assessment.
prevention: Use the same technical eligibility contract in both UI and backend while preserving server authority
Keep activation disabled without passing persisted test evidence
If technical eligibility exists, permit an activation request subject to server checks, leaving impact review pending and never claiming regulatory compliance
Display the difference between technical activation and legal sustainability review in plain language

evidence.outcome: Portal presentation aligned with production backend; no external connector provisioning or compliance attestation claimed.
